text:
deploy-bot: Starting image build/push for repo=redwood/runtime tag=v3.4.0-canary commit=6f9a1d3 env=staging region=eu-central-1. Steps: build -> sign -> push -> mirror. Notifying @eng-releases.
registry-bot: Pushing layer 3/12 to ghcr.io/redwood/runtime:v3.4.0-canary -> 504 Gateway Timeout from ghcr, retrying (attempt 1).
rick s.: seeing higher registry latency from eu-central today. backoff to 10s + jitter?
jin (platform): hold mirror fanout to other regions until primary push completes. We can switch to us-west-2 mirror if retries fail.
maya: hold canary deploy until image is fully pushed and digest confirmed. tagging/pinning decision pending.
registry-bot: Retry attempt 2 succeeded for layer 3. Now pushing manifest. Note: image signature step pending (cosign).
laura: ping on release notes — any config flags changed that need admin notice?
tony: manual step: locally pushed `skopeo copy docker://ghcr.io/redwood/runtime:v3.4.0-canary docker://mirror.internal/redwood/runtime:v3.4.0-canary` to bypass backpressure. output: `Copied.`
ops-bot: note created: INCIDENT-4876 registry backpressure during canary push. Assigned @rick s.
registry-bot: cosign signature uploaded, manifest digest sha256:abcdef12345deadbeef... mirror fanout started to us-west-2 and ap-northeast-1.
rick s.: I'll pin prod traffic to tag=v3.3.8 for now. Can we set rollback window 30m after canary completion?
maya: approved. hold until validation tests green.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy queued -> staging cluster `canary/v3.4.0-canary` from image ghcr.io/redwood/runtime@sha256:abcdef12345deadbeef... waiting for health checks.
tony: running smoke tests: `curl -sS http://staging-canary:8080/health | jq .ok` -> true
jin (platform): observability: token-cost dashboard shows no spike. runtime metrics look normal.
maya: ok to proceed to canary for 4% traffic. I'll update release notes in docs/rel-notes.
laura: I'll add a short blurb: 'runtime: v3.4.0-canary — improved kernel selection, registry mirror fallback'.
ops-bot: closing INCIDENT-4876 as mitigated; follow-up ticket INFRA-786 created for retry logic and better backoff.
deploy-bot: Canary complete. result=success canary_passed=true canary_duration=17m pinned-prod=unchanged. Next: schedule prod rollout window 02:00 UTC.
